scope: Mathematical prerequisites and negative controls only; zero candidate world-model experiments completed.

I01.interpretation: FM optimum is not a constant multiple of Gaussian entropy over varying residual variance. This does not estimate the real model's likelihood or prove a calibrated replacement.

I02.condition: Both posterior and prior, including entry reference distribution, must transform. A fixed unit prior is not invariant under arbitrary linear scaling.

I03.interpretation: Correlated posterior noise requires a new conditional KL; keeping the old independent formula misprices the same Gaussian chain.

I04.caveat: Requires separable subspaces in this toy; arbitrary anchor subtraction can remove absolute geometry. No image canonicalizer has been validated.

I06.interpretation: The constrained update can improve FM while increasing the original priced objective. It must be evaluated as a changed optimization rule.

I07.caveat: Variance predictor must not read target pixels; this regression identity does not make weighted FM an endpoint NLL.

I08.condition: A toy can have stable latent recurrence and unstable encode/decode feedback. If E*D=I, the two recurrences are equivalent. Neither condition is established for trained Native by this toy.

I10.caveat: Ridge must use covariant C, not a fixed identity. Local control Jacobians and PushT benefit remain untested.
